question: What is the main objective of zero-based budgeting?

options.text: To assess the effectiveness of each programme and activity with the output
Establishing a relationship between inputs and outputs
Examining the objectives for which funds are provided
Re-evaluation of all the activities every year when budget provisions are made

solution:
The correct answer is __**Re-evaluation of all the activities every year when budget provisions are made**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Zero-based budgeting (ZBB)** is a budgeting method where all expenses must be justified for each new period.
 
• In ZBB, every function within an organization is analyzed for its needs and costs.
 
• The primary objective is the **re-evaluation of all activities annually**, ensuring that funds are allocated efficiently.
 
• It starts from a "zero base" and every function is reviewed comprehensively.
 
• This method encourages cost management and helps in identifying and eliminating unnecessary expenditures.
 
• ZBB is used to allocate resources based on the necessity and efficiency of projects.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **To assess the effectiveness of each programme and activity with the output**__

 __
 
• This option pertains to **performance budgeting** where the focus is on outcomes and outputs of programs.
 
• Performance budgeting links funds allocated to measurable results.
 
 
 
• **Establishing a relationship between inputs and outputs**__
 __
 
• This approach is often seen in **output budgeting** or **performance-based budgeting**.
 
• It focuses on efficiency by examining how inputs (resources) are converted into outputs (services).
 
 
 
• **Examining the objectives for which funds are provided**__
 
 
• This option is related to **program budgeting**, which allocates funds according to the objectives of each program.
 
• Program budgeting aims to allocate resources based on programs' goals and objectives.
